current.summary: L-shaped kitchen, largely fitted. Base units in IKEA olive green with raised-panel doors (they look teal in photos because the protective film is still on) and a glossy dark walnut-effect worktop. Sink run: black inset sink with black pull-out tap, slim dishwasher, grey-green metro-tile splashback finished with a brass trim, dark charcoal glazed wall cabinets with an open shelf below. Hob run: 4-burner gas hob, built-in stainless oven, black chimney hood, splashback in square pale-green tiles with brass trim. A wooden window to the front sits over the corner of the worktop. The arched opening beside the hob leads to the lounge (currently covered with a black sheet). Oak-tone glazed double doors lead to the back terrace. Floor: large light-grey stone-effect tiles with matching tile skirting. Recessed ceiling downlights. The far end opens to the fridge & utility room and the bathroom door.
keep: Olive-green units (IKEA), walnut-effect worktop, black sink and tap
Both tiled splashbacks with their brass trims
issues: JOB 1 — Handles: 3 drawers, 5 cupboard doors, dishwasher, 2 for the IKEA wall cupboard = 11
JOB 2 — Extractor hood (recirculating): wire in and finish — hidden connection, carbon filters, chimney cover
JOB 3 — Fit the new IKEA wall cupboard (black, reeded glass, 60 × 80 cm, 2 doors) in the corner to the left of the hood
JOB 4 — Electrics: make safe the open junction box by the terrace doors and the open hole high on the wall
JOB 5 — Walls and ceiling: make good patches, holes and cracks at the downlights, then paint
JOB 6 — Front window: finish the frame and reveal
JOB 7 — Close off the raw end panel of the hob run
To decide: terrace-door inside sill/threshold finish

target.concept: The kitchen itself is done; seven jobs finish the room around it: handles, the hood wired in, the IKEA cupboard up, electrics safe, walls and ceiling smooth and painted warm white, the window finished and the unit end closed. No change to units, worktop, tiles or appliances.

furniture.name: Handles — recommendation: aged/brushed brass
furniture.detail: Brass picks up the tile trims and the terrace-door handles. 5 knobs (about 30 mm) for cupboard doors, 3 cup pulls for drawers, 1 bar handle about 160 mm for the dishwasher (a knob is too weak for a sprung door), 2 knobs for the IKEA wall cupboard. Before buying: check whether the doors are already drilled and measure the hole spacing.

furniture.name: New IKEA wall cupboard
furniture.detail: On order: IKEA black wall cabinet with reeded-glass doors, 60 cm wide × 80 cm high, 2 doors. Goes in the corner left of the hood, on the painted wall above the brass trim. Space measured: 83 cm high × 68 cm wide — it fits with 3 cm spare in height and 8 cm in width. Sit it just above the brass trim; leave about 3 cm at the corner wall so the left door can open fully, about 5 cm to the hood. Paint that wall BEFORE hanging.

target.renderPrompt:
Edit this photo of a room in our house. Keep the exact camera angle and keep all the architecture exactly as it is — walls, room shape, windows, doors, beams, floor and fixed fittings. Do not add, move or remove anything structural, and do not change the furniture unless I say so below. Remove all clutter: tools, boxes, bags, dust sheets, loose cables, packaging, laundry and toiletries. Show the room finished and tidy.

Changes to make:
- Keep the kitchen exactly as built: olive-green raised-panel units (matt olive, not teal; no protective film), glossy dark walnut-effect worktop, black sink and tap, grey-green metro tiles and square pale-green tiles with brass trim, gas hob, steel oven, black chimney hood, charcoal glazed wall cabinets, light grey floor tiles.
- Add aged-brass handles: round knobs on the cupboard doors, cup pulls on the three drawers, a bar handle on the dishwasher.
- Add one black wall cabinet with two reeded-glass doors (60 cm wide, 80 cm high) in the corner to the left of the hood, sitting just above the brass tile trim.
- The hood is finished, with its chimney cover up to the ceiling and no hanging cable.
- Walls smooth and painted warm white; ceiling smooth off-white with neat downlights, no holes or cracks.
- The window frame and its surround are neatly finished. The end panel of the hob run is finished.
- The arched opening is open (no black sheet), showing a glimpse of the lounge beyond.

Style: photorealistic interior photograph, natural light plus warm 2700K lamps, no people, no text or labels.
